reuse.why: Linking reuses the existing linkSimpleFinAccount flow (bank lookup, upgrade/insert, initial sync, sync-event) and guardBankAccountLink rather than writing another copy, and the download goes through the shared post/BankSyncError/getServer plumbing.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error checks, response mapping) instead of sharing a single-account download helper.

placement.why: Handler registration, link function, download function, server URL and types each land in the files where the other providers live.

scope.why: Focused on the Fintegra provider; the only unrelated touch is adding updatedPreview to an existing SimpleFin test mock.

maintainability.why: Making Fintegra a `provider` mode of a function named linkSimpleFinAccount, with an `'orgDomain' in externalAccount` type probe, couples two providers under a misleading name; a generic org-based link helper would read better.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses findOrCreateBank, guardBankAccountLink, handleSyncResponse via the reused link flow, and the existing syncAccount dispatch.

disguised_duplication.where: The download function is an open copy of the Akahu/PluggyAi pattern, not a renamed or reshaped one.
